segments.name: investment management and related services
segments.description: Provides investment management and related services to retail, institutional and high-net-worth investors worldwide.
segments.evidence: We have one operating segment, investment management and related services.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay investment management fees, generally a percentage of the assets under management in the accounts advised.
revenueModel.evidence: Our fees for providing investment management services are generally based on a percentage of AUM in the accounts that we advise, and vary based on asset class, type of services provided, and the market for those services.
